CreateOrderRequest.description: Request body for creating a DRAFT order

customerId.description: Customer id (the order is for this customer)

lines.description: Order lines. One to 100 distinct SKUs.

reservationWarehouseId.description: Original verified checkout warehouse; null when historical provenance is unknown

LineRequest.description: A line in a create-order request

paymentId.description: Durable payment intent reference; absent on historical orders

placedAt.description: When the order was placed (null while DRAFT)

statusHistory.description: Status history (only included in detail view)

reservationId.description: Durable inventory reservation reference; absent on historical lines

first.description: True if this is the first page

last.description: True if this is the last page

extensions.description: Additional properties, as allowed by RFC 7807

instance.description: URI reference for this specific occurrence

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type

ShippingAddressRequest.description: Shipping address in a create-order request

bearerAuth.description: Keycloak access token; customer_id identifies the customer owner.

info.description: Verified owner or administrator order access, durable checkout and lifecycle recovery. Pending work returns HTTP 202.
info.title: Order Service API

get.summary: List orders: verified owner with an explicit customerId filter, or administrator
Get an order by its order number
